presets.name: Micrometeor Rain
presets.description: Countless tiny impacts on a hull: high crackle sparkling in a long stereo echo.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Orbital Debris Field
presets.description: Tumbling fragments: metallic Magnetar shards drifting in and out of phase.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Carrier Wave
presets.description: Tuning across a dead band: a pure carrier sliding under bursts of white noise and hiss.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Crystal Lattice
presets.description: A frozen pattern of glints: quantized Quasar steps pinging through a tempo echo.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Sunquake
presets.description: Helioseismic rumble: deep, slow pressure waves rolling under a seething surface hiss.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Telemetry Noise Floor
presets.description: Data from a failing probe: stuttering bit-quantized fragments under the hiss.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Bell Chamber Echoes
presets.description: A shimmering metallic cloud: comb-filtered ring mod hanging in a very long reverb.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Exoplanet Rainforest
presets.description: An alien canopy at night: chirping, filtered pink-noise calls in a dense wet space.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Dyson Swarm
presets.description: Millions of collectors circling a star: dense detuned motion that glitters and swirls.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tine Of Titan
presets.description: A warm tine piano: a soft sine body with a bell-bright bark that grows with velocity.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Wurlitzer Wanderer
presets.description: A reedy, slightly nasal electric piano that barks when you dig in.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pulsar Clavinet
presets.description: A funky, percussive clav: a narrow pulse through a snapping resonant low-pass.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Drawbar Observatory
presets.description: Full drawbars through a spinning cabinet: the mod wheel throws it to fast.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Click Track Organ
presets.description: A percussive organ with a key click and a second-harmonic blip that fades fast.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ground Station Organ
presets.description: A house organ stab: hollow, punchy, made for offbeat chords.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Digital Piano 1984
presets.description: A crystalline FM piano from the era of the first space shuttles.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Toy Rover
presets.description: A toy piano left on Mars: thin tines, a little out of tune, very small.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Vibraphone Of Vega
presets.description: Soft mallets on metal bars with the motor on: the tremolo follows the mod wheel.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Marimba Keys
presets.description: Hollow wooden keys tuned in a formant filter: woody, round and quick.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Dark Room Rhodes
presets.description: A dusty tine piano through a tube: low, intimate, a bit of grit under the hammer.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Station Keys
presets.description: A bright digital poly key for comping: the Fraunhofer lines give it a glassy top.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Harpsichord Hyperion
presets.description: A plucked baroque register: two bright strings an octave apart, quick and courtly.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Koto Of Kepler
presets.description: A plucked silk string with a bending attack: the pitch settles a breath after the pick.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Harp Of Lyra
presets.description: A concert harp across the constellations: round, gentle, long ringing strings.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Marimba Moon
presets.description: A low marimba: a sine with a hollow knock that disappears in a moment.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Kalimba Signal
presets.description: A thumb piano with a metal tongue: the comb filter rings at the note.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Staccato Satellites
presets.description: Short, bowed string stabs in tight unison: a pizzicato section in orbit.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Nylon Telescope
presets.description: A soft nylon-string guitar: a hollow body, a bright pick, a short sustain.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Steel String Comet
presets.description: A bright steel-string strum with a long metallic shimmer behind it.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: FM Spark
presets.description: A short FM blip: the index falls in a few milliseconds, leaving a clean sine.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Cavity Ring-Down
presets.description: A noise burst ringing in a tuned comb: a struck tube, half string, half wind.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Future Pluck Chord
presets.description: A wide, sidechain-shaped supersaw chord pluck for future bass drops.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Dewdrop Pluck
presets.description: A tiny, liquid water-drop pluck: the filter sweeps up as the note falls away.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pulsar Mallet
presets.description: A wooden mallet with a pulsar's attack: periodic, percussive, quickly gone.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Quantum Banjo
presets.description: A twangy, nasal pluck from a quantised wave: half banjo, half bitcrusher.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Slingshot Pluck
presets.description: A deep pluck that swings past the low end and slingshots up through the filter.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tubular Transit
presets.description: Orchestral tubular bells: a deep strike with an inharmonic hum that hangs in the hall.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Glass Planetarium
presets.description: Struck glass under a dome: pure, high and a little cold.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Gamelan Of Ganymede
presets.description: A bronze gong-chime: ring modulation tuned just off the octave beats against itself.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Music Box Voyager
presets.description: A wind-up music box on the Golden Record: tiny comb teeth, a soft mechanical tick.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Celesta Constellation
presets.description: A celesta's soft metal plates over felt hammers: sugar-plum stardust.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Cathedral Of Ceres
presets.description: A great church bell: a low strike, a minor-third hum and a tail that won't stop.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Solar Wind Chimes
presets.description: Aluminium chimes stirred by the solar wind: random strikes in a slow breeze.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Magnetar Bell
presets.description: A hard, bright FM strike from the Magnetar table: modern and metallic.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ion Cloud Bells
presets.description: Detuned bells swimming in chorus: soft attacks, glowing like an ion trail.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Event Horizon Gong
presets.description: A gong falling into a black hole: the fold deepens as it rings out.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Formant Chime
presets.description: A chime that almost speaks: the formant filter tunes a vowel into its ring.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Satellite Carillon
presets.description: A tower of small bells rung from orbit: bright, interlocking, made for melodies.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Trance Gate Nova
presets.description: A supersaw arpeggio in 16ths, gated hard and climbing two octaves: the classic euphoric lift.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Neon Grid Runner
presets.description: Synthwave eighths on a bright pulse with a ping-pong echo, cruising down a grid at night.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Kepler Cascade
presets.description: Down-and-up triplets through a glassy Quasar table: water falling between three moons.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Played Constellation
presets.description: Plays your chord back exactly as you drew it, star by star, with a halo of echoes.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Converging Orbits
presets.description: Notes from the outside in: the chord folds toward its centre like satellites decaying.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Diverging Jets
presets.description: From the middle out: twin jets of a quasar spraying notes to both registers.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Chord Pulsar
presets.description: Whole chords fired like a pulsar beam, with off-beat accents and a stutter at the bar's end.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Orbital Resonance
presets.description: The Orbit mode circling the chord in 1/8T while a resonant filter traces its ellipse.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pulsar Clockwork
presets.description: Pulsar mode ticking out the chord with machine precision; ratchets mark every fourth beat.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Asteroid Belt
presets.description: Random notes over four octaves at 60% probability: rocks tumbling through the dark.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: 8-Bit Probe
presets.description: Chiptune arpeggio on a quantised square: a lander sending home scores in 1/32 notes.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Swing State
presets.description: A loose, swung down-arp on Rhodes-like FM, for late-night house and lo-fi grooves.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Hyperion Steps
presets.description: Big-room trance in triplet 16ths; every fourth note leaps an octave on a bright wavetable sweep.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Lunar Lullaby
presets.description: A slow, latched up/down arpeggio in quarter notes, soft as moonlight on a cold sea.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Retro Rocket Lane
presets.description: Dotted-eighth echo arpeggio, the U2-style guitar delay reborn as a rocket's flashing lights.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Polymeter Planets
presets.description: A five-step lane against a four-on-the-floor: planets lapping each other in a 5:4 resonance.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Berlin Ascent
presets.description: Berlin-school ostinato: a resonant saw sequence with a slow filter climb, hypnotic for minutes.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Phobos Patrol
presets.description: Dark electro: a syncopated bass sequence with octave jumps and a ratcheted pickup.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Minimal Transit
presets.description: Minimal techno blip: one note, a moving accent and microscopic filter changes per step.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Glitch Telemetry
presets.description: IDM data stream: ratchets, rests and wild transposes at 70% probability, never quite repeating.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Synthwave Drive Sequence
presets.description: Driving eighth-note bass in octaves under a pink-neon sky, glide on the jumps.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: House Of Titan
presets.description: A classic house organ-stab riff with off-beat chords and a ghost note before the one.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Seven Sisters
presets.description: A seven-step polymeter in Pleiades blue: odd-length phrase drifting against the bar.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Acid Equinox
presets.description: Acid line with slides on legato steps, accents that bite and an octave run at the end.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Space Invader March
presets.description: Chiptune march: square-wave bass descending four steps, the arcade cabinet in orbit.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Vangelis Relay
presets.description: A cinematic brass sequence under a vast hall, in the style of eighties sci-fi scores.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Morse Pulsar
presets.description: A short, rhythmic beep code at 1/16T, like a pulsar mistaken for a message.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Breakbeat Comet
presets.description: A breakbeat-shaped pluck sequence with ghost notes and rolls, made for jungle and DnB.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Converge Engine
presets.description: Converge mode at 1/16 with a transposing lane: an engine spooling up toward ignition.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Kraut Satellite
presets.description: Motorik eighths on a reedy Nebula organ, endlessly forward like a probe leaving the system.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ascension Riser
presets.description: An eight-second white-noise and saw riser that opens and accelerates into the drop.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Orbital Decay Downlifter
presets.description: A falling, filtering sweep: a satellite losing altitude and burning up in the hiss.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Red Alert Siren
presets.description: A two-tone starship alarm whooping on a square LFO; Orbit speeds it toward panic.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Proximity Warning
presets.description: Cockpit beeps that quicken as the mod wheel comes up: something is closing fast.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Deep Space Transmission
presets.description: A crackling radio carrier through the formant filter, voices half-heard across the void.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Android Diplomat
presets.description: A robot voice on the formant filter: vowels shaped by an envelope, words in an alien tongue.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Plasma Rifle
presets.description: A fat sci-fi blaster: pitch dives two octaves through drive and a short, bright slap.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ion Engine Spool-Up
presets.description: The low hum of a ship at rest: a beating sub drone with a slow thermal shimmer above it.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Quantum Teleport
presets.description: Dematerialise: a rising shimmer of ratcheted, randomised partials vanishing into the reverb.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Hyperspace Whoosh
presets.description: A wide stereo noise sweep through the band-pass: the stars stretching into lines and back.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Asteroid Impact
presets.description: A sub-heavy impact with a gritty crackle tail and a long cavern of reverb.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Data Corruption
presets.description: Bit-crushed glitch bursts: random pitch, ratchets and folds, a hard drive failing in orbit.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Solar Sail Unfurl
presets.description: A slow metallic swell through the comb filter, sheets of foil catching the sunlight.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Countdown Pulse
presets.description: A launch-control tone that beeps once a beat and climbs a semitone per bar when the arp runs.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Solar Ensemble
presets.description: A divide-down string machine through a thick three-phase chorus: the sound of a hundred 70s records.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Eminent Domain
presets.description: An organ-born ensemble: bright octave-up pulses with a slow, swimming phase.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Vox Polaris
presets.description: Polymoog-style vox strings: a formant body under the ensemble, half choir and half bow.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pulsewidth Nebula
presets.description: Juno-style strings: one pulse oscillator, its width breathing, through the chorus.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Oberon Strings
presets.description: Brassy two-oscillator strings with a filter that swells into each chord: big, warm, 1979.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Prophecy Strings
presets.description: A polished five-voice-era string patch: saw and pulse, a soft filter sweep, gently detuned.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Off-World Dawn
presets.description: CS-80 expressive strings: press into a chord and it brightens and sings with vibrato.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Neon Horizon Strings
presets.description: 80s soundtrack strings: wide, bright and a little glossy, made for the title sequence.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Galactic Section
presets.description: A full string section with a slow bow: the attack swells in and the body opens with it.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Lone Violin of Vega
presets.description: A solo violin line: legato glide, a resonant body, and vibrato that arrives after the note settles.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Saturnine Cello
presets.description: A cello voice: dark, woody, a little rosin at the start of each stroke.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Contrabass Gravity Well
presets.description: Section basses in the lowest octave: slow bows, deep and heavy, the floor of the orchestra.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pizzicato Pulsars
presets.description: Plucked strings: a short, round snap with a little wood, and a hall around it.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Spiccato Countdown
presets.description: A staccato string ostinato on the arp: driving 16ths with bowed accents, ready for the chase scene.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tremolo Transmission
presets.description: Bowed tremolo: a section trembling fast and quiet, rising with the mod wheel.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ponticello Ice
presets.description: Sul ponticello: bowed at the bridge, glassy and thin, all upper partials and frost.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Flautando Halo
presets.description: Harmonics and flautando: airy, breathy, barely touching the string, more air than tone.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Octave Binary
presets.description: Unison strings doubled at the octave: violins and violas together, a broad singing line.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Hybrid Ascension
presets.description: A cinematic hybrid swell: strings rising out of a filtered pulse bed, the trailer crescendo in one note.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Umbra Low Strings
presets.description: Dark low strings for the shadow side: cellos and basses, muted and menacing.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Shimmering Rings
presets.description: Strings in an enormous space: a long glittering tail that keeps ringing after the bow lifts.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Morphing Magnetosphere
presets.description: Evolving wavetable strings: a slow sweep through the Pulsar frames turns the section's colour over time.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tape From Voyager
presets.description: Lo-fi strings off a worn tape: detuned, gently wobbling in pitch, the highs rolled away.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Supersaw Strings of Orion
presets.description: A wall of eight-voice saws played like a string pad: huge, bright and euphoric.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Heliosphere Bed
presets.description: An ambient string bed with a very long release: chords hang and overlap as you move between them.
presets.author: Chromosphere
